scientific_integrity.claimed_contribution: Global quantitative near-optimal edge-weight stability and consequent unrestricted uniqueness for wheel fastest-mixing reversible stochastic kernels. The exact optimum value and invariant optimal probabilities are prior results.

Finite verification uses numerical floating-point tolerances
